label: AC!D 2 — Residential Area, vestibule intérieur
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one individual static Metal Gear AC!D 2 environment source for CQC.
The inputs are native gameplay reference contact sheets displayed within a decorative PSP console border. Use ONLY the in-game scenery; no sheet layout, no PSP, no UI, no words or characters in the output.
Subject: Stage08 Residential Area, the ornate interior vestibule seen in the first two frames of input1, with input1 middle-left and input2 bottom frames providing a high view of the same location. Produce a SINGLE bounded interior vignette of the door and adjoining landing. Preserve the front-facing, slightly elevated camera of input1 first frame: a plain light olive/beige rectangular door inset between dark green-black marble piers flecked with gold/ochre veining; restrained amber light washes the piers near their tops; dark green wall framing and the pale teal/green floor strip run horizontally at the base. A portion of the red patterned floor/carpet of the adjacent landing visible from the elevated gameplay views may appear at the lower edge. Match the original vibrant cel-shaded AC!D 2 surfaces and deliberately simple geometric forms, with crisp detailed rendering and realistic material texture that does not redesign the space. Keep this a modest corridor/vestibule, not a palace.
Do not expand into an invented entire residential district, an outdoor street or generic modern lobby. No additional doors, plants, flags, chairs, neon signs, computers, luxury chandeliers or statues. Do not include the ambiguous center display/planter from distant views; this request is only for the clearly visible doorway and landing. Remove Snake, Venus, Dalton, portraits, dialogue boxes, cards, movement tiles, crosshairs, and every overlay. One opaque landscape16:9 scene, no collage and no caption.
